facts.fact: Sponsored Display is now known as display ads
facts.quote: Sponsored Display is now known as display ads

facts.fact: The new platform connects display campaigns with customers across Amazon properties including Twitch, Fire TV, and Echo Show, as well as premium placements across the open internet
facts.quote: connects your display campaigns with customers across Amazon properties including Twitch, Fire TV, and Echo Show, as well as premium placements across the open internet

facts.fact: The new platform is a single ad platform that unifies access to all Amazon Ads products, bringing together sponsored ads and Amazon DSP workflows
facts.quote: a single ad platform that unifies access to all Amazon Ads products, bringing together sponsored ads and Amazon DSP workflows

facts.fact: Existing Sponsored Display campaigns continue to run uninterrupted
facts.quote: Existing Sponsored Display campaigns will continue to run uninterrupted

facts.fact: You can access existing Sponsored Display campaigns through Campaign Manager in the Ads Console
facts.quote: access your existing Sponsored Display campaigns through Campaign Manager in the Ads Console

facts.fact: To create new display campaigns, go to Campaigns, click Create Campaign, and then click Display
facts.quote: go to Campaigns, click Create Campaign, and then click Display

facts.fact: Display ads are flexible ad formats that help brands reach relevant audiences wherever they spend time
facts.quote: Display ads are flexible ad formats that can help your brand reach relevant audiences wherever they spend time

facts.fact: Display ads support both Amazon-generated creative and custom creative assets
facts.quote: using Amazon-generated creative or your own creative assets
